title: Wgpu Winit Trunk Migration
description: Migrate the raw-wgpu OS/playground stack from browser-only wasm-bindgen/web-sys to winit windowing/input (native + web) and trunk build tooling, plus native hot-swappable plugin hosting.
summary: Refined print OS window chrome to match the real UI U-cutout shape. `semio-window.sty` now draws a three-segment header (name tab left, canvas gap middle, hierarchy number right) with per-side tcolorbox rules and `-1px` body overlap; sections use a breakable body box, chapters remain header-only bands. All `\chapter`/`\section` calls (including starred) always increment counters and show hierarchy numbers in the right cap. `print/script.ts` emits exact chrome metrics from `tokens.metrics.chrome` (title bar height 1.4em, padding 0.2em, font sizes 0.7em/0.6em). Six templates split into `.content.tex` + light/dark wrappers; `zukunftbau.cls` forwards `theme` option. All 12 template PDFs and mit-bestand zwischenbericht build successfully.
